lines.text: Please, oh merciful Creator, bring happiness upon these people.
Fill them with your light and bless them with eternal hope.
Please allow the rippling muscles of those men fill my dreams.
All I want is to remember every moment spent with you. Is that too much to ask?
Believer, tell me, when can we finally submit to our desire to do whatever we wish?

Oh my! Such skillful hands...
Very impressive, as expected.
I must go pray. Feel free to call upon me if you have any needs.

You pretend not to care so that I will let my guard down, is that it?
What if I have a moment of weakness? What will you do to me then?!
If there is such a thing as Paradise, surely it is this place. I would love to live here.
I certainly hope there aren't any graves lying around here.
There must be hidden areas all over this place.
May the Creator bless you for never losing your faith, even during your darkest hours.
It's been quite some time since someone looked after me like this.
Oh. You really don't hold back.
It would be nice if I was a bit more... well-rounded in certain areas.
Thank you. May the Creator bless you, Believer.
Would you like to make a donation? Oh... it's for me?
What are you trying to do? It... It can't be...!
Believer, you are virtuous. The sooner I tie you down, the better... I mean... F-forget I said anything!
Believer, you must trust your instincts completely.
No, I cannot allow myself to be conquered by you like this!
I'm always by your side.
I'm ready.
You want me to get on it? W-wait, that didn't come out right...
Everybody get ready.
No one will get hurt.
I will look over everyone.
May the Creator bless us.
No! The power of my prayers are declining.
Sorry, please wait a minute.
May all of us remain standing.
I'm ready.
The Garden of Shangri-La, no pain or despair!
Please guide us all to the light!
Eh?
My goodness.
Whoa!
Ow!
Errggh!
*Gasp*
I may have fallen... but so long as all of you are safe...
We will also emerge victorious, so long as we never give up hope.
